updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot


User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may be unable to view the Pay-As-You-Go (PAYG) breakdown in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may be unable to view the PAYG breakdown in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Affected admins are seeing the following message:
 
"Breakdown unavailable

We couldn't load the Pre-purchased (P3) versus pay-as-you-go breakdown right now. Please try again later."

Current status: Our monitoring has identified an increase in errors when loading the PAYG breakdown pane within the Microsoft 365 admin center. We've analyzed browser captures and determined that a recent change to an API that facilitates PAYG breakdown reporting isn't responding to requests as expected, resulting in impact. We're in the process of developing a fix to remediate this issue and will provide a remediation timeline once available.

Scope of impact: Any admin attempting to access the PAYG breakdown pane within the Microsoft 365 admin center may be affected. 

Next update by: Friday, September 18, 2026, at 6:30 PM UTC
